top_picks.title: Ben Dwork's Post
top_picks.author: LinkedIn
top_picks.summary: ## More Relevant Posts - Jeganathan Palanisamy 2w - Report this post The fastest way to get surprised on 15 September is to still think “AI bots” is one switch. It is not. Cloudflare now lets site owners control three kinds of crawlers separately: Search, Agent, and Training. From 15 September, new domains block Agent and Training by default on pages that show ads. Search stays allowed. Existing free sites that never changed the setting get the same default. A more practical way to think about this is to work backwards from what the traffic is actually doing: 1. Is it indexing your content to answer questions later? That is Search. Still allowed by default. 2. Is it taking your content to train or fine-tune a model? That is Training. Blocked on ad pages by default. … 3.Is it acting in real time on a person’s behalf, right now? That is Agent. Chat fetch bots. Browser-use agents. Also bloc
